text:
Palladium Price in 2011
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2011, the LBMA palladium price fell 21.8% between 2011-01-31 ($806) and 2011-12-29 ($630). The highest sampled price was $824 in July and the lowest was $614 in September. The mean of these observations was $733. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2011:
Gold set what was then an all-time high near $1,900 amid the European debt crisis and the first-ever downgrade of the US credit rating.
